parsed.summary: The PR refactors AutocompleteJsonView to support extra fields in the autocomplete response by introducing a new method serialize_result. The change is minimal and maintains readability.

issues.description: The docstring for the new method serialize_result could be more detailed to explain its purpose and parameters.
